from: 2. A Credit Invoice exists mixing a returned-part line (with a restocking fee) and a money-only credit line.
to: 2. Two Credit Invoices: one raised from returned parts, at least one line of it carrying a restocking fee, and one money-only credit. To make a credit for returned parts: click "Parts" in the top menu, click "Part Sales", open a part sale whose status is "paid", click the "Finance" tab, click the three-dot button on that tab's toolbar and choose "Issue Credit". That window lists the parts under "Parts to return", each with a "Qty To Credit" and a "Restocking Fee" box; set the quantity you are crediting, type the fee, choose "Issue Store Credit" under "Outcome", type a short note in "Reason", and click "Issue Credit". To make a money-only credit instead: click "Customers" in the top menu, open a customer, click the "Invoices" tab, click "Issue Credit", type the amount in "Amount", choose "Issue Store Credit" under "Outcome", type a short note in "Reason", and click "Issue Credit".
